Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 110: June 2010
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #110 shipped to subscribers in May 2010 (bearing the cover date of June 2010 for Issue 110). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #110 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, custom downloadable content, and exclusive media previews:

Transformers: War for Cybertron (third-person action shooter)
Singularity (first-person sci-fi shooter)
NCAA Football 11 (sports simulation)
Limbo (Xbox Live Arcade puzzle-platformer)
Hydro Thunder Hurricane (Xbox Live Arcade powerboat racing)
Blacklight: Tango Down (Xbox Live Arcade multiplayer FPS)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews--featuring E3 2010 expectations, Call of Duty: Black Ops, and Gears of War 3, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
